Results.ReviewText: I like the new grill, and I especially like the solid handles and heat shield.  Ash pan seems nice as well.  I am fond of the lid holder, but wish they would have still included the internal hook on the lid because sometime you just want to hang it on the side of the grill rather than have it high up as a shield.  I like the hole in the center of the grate for loading charcoal, but there is no way to hang on to it when removing it, and no place to put it when removing it.  It would be useful to either have a tool for removal, or a hanger on it to hang it on the edge of the grill
Results.Title: Nice newer grill some features need improvements

Results.ReviewText: I read some reviews about quality issues but that wasn’t my experience at all. The grill assembled easily and the lid fit properly to hold in heat. The heat shield on the handle has worked perfectly as well. Definitely stayed cooler to lift then my last grill where I needed a mitt when the grill was hot. I’m very happy with what I got.

Results.ReviewText: While the Weber Master-Touch 22" grill works flawlessly I think some better instructions should be included on how to properly use the charcoal trays when trying to either reverse sere or smoke something. My initial intent with this purchase was to use a a direct heat method when grilling. I am sure it will take practice and more use to get better at using the Weber Master-Touch for purposes that aren't "normal" use. I do however love the center removable grate and the accessories that are available to use. I did purchase the "WOK" insert and it works like advertised. This 3 star rating is only meant to get Weber thinking on how it can either include instructions in the box or maybe link to a video on how to use as a smoker.
Results.Title: How can I use it to Smoke?

Results.ReviewText:
Just used this grill yesterday for the first time and found it to be excellent. The grill is top notch and the customer service is world class. I'm no expert and have a lot to learn but I can already see that the included accessories give you a lot of flexibility. The included charcoal baskets make it possible to use less (or more) charcoal depending on the size of the cook, and want kind of grilling or smoking you want to do. You can place both baskets in the center of the grill or place one on each side of the grill. The included optional grill grate has a removable center piece that allows you to focus the grilling or searing in the center of the grill and you can easily add more charcoal to the baskets if needed. You could also separate the two included charcoal baskets and put one on each side of the grill for smoking. With this configuration you can cook in the center portion of the grill and then sear over one or both of the charcoal baskets on the edge of the grill. The grill grate has hinged grates on each side that you can lift up to add more charcoal if necessary. I haven't used this feature yet but it's very obvious how convenient it will be. The thermometer in the lid of the grill is very handy to show you the overall internal temperature of the grill itself, but I'll still use a meat thermometer for the precise meat temps. The lid thermometer will be good for seasoning cast iron pieces. Haven't yet used the included warming rack that sits on top of the grill grate. This looks to be better for bigger jobs. There is LOTS of room inside this grill. I chose this grill because it sits a little higher than the other grills and for extra accessories that came with it. This grill has just about everything you need for grilling or smoking except for maybe a meat thermometer. I ordered a Slow-N-Sear package from another vendor, as well as a Vortex product. I won't be using either of these products anytime soon because this grill, as delivered, seems to have everything I already need. This grill is a superb product as-is. Now having said all this, I'm thinking about ordering the Weber Jumbo Joe for everyday grilling. It's just the wife and I most of the time and the Master-Touch is best for more than two people.  EXTREMELY happy with this grill. 
Oh, and one more thing - Weber Customer Service. These people are the best. I installed the triangle assembly upside down when I put the grill together. Totally my fault. This is the part that braces the three legs of the grill. To fix this I needed to remove the wheels and reinstall the triangle right-side up. The only problem is the little hub caps that hold each wheel in place can't be reused. The Weber Customer Service person was friendly, efficient and sent me a new set of hub caps at no charge and no questions asked.

I’m buying ingredients I’ve never thought I’d be buying like achiote paste and tamarind pulp, I recently smoked a brisket on the Weber as well and with the Weber and YouTube nothing can stop me mofos!

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill and the fact that I can have different and awesome accessories giving me a diverse cooking  experience.  The only thing keeping it from  being a 5 the gage  It's not accurate to relaying the temperature.
Results.Title: Versatile grill.

Results.ReviewText:
I used a Webber grill in the 70 & 80's but I moved and the Webber got left behind. I hadn't purchased another Webber until about 2 weeks ago when I purchased the Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22". 
 Using the Webber brings back lots of good grilling memories! The new Webber works great. I really like the new ash clean out , tuck away lid holder and hinged gourmet cooking grate. The two coal baskets are great for indirect cooking which I often do. 
I am really glad I purchased the grill. It does everything I need in a grill. I would recommended this grill to anyone who likes to grill.
Results.Title: 22" Master Touch, Like finding an old friend!

Results.ReviewText:
I love this grill. For me, basic is best and the innovations Weber has introduced over the last twenty years are greatly appreciated.
Keep up the great work, we now have three Weber grills in our family.
Results.Title: Strong Work Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber.  We have the 26, but couldn't do rotisserie on it.  So we had to get the 22".  The ivory is beautiful and the rotisserie works perfectly.
Results.Title: Master-Touch Masterpiece in Ivory

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
